svg.title: TX and RX on an intercom
svg.desc: A simple hand-drawn wide picture. On the left an apartment door with an intercom panel beside it; a person in a blue T-shirt presses a button on the panel. On the right, a window on the second floor; a person in a green T-shirt holds the intercom handset to the ear, and the bubble says "Who is it?". The two wires between them cross in the middle: the blue wire runs from the door's microphone to the earpiece upstairs, marked "TX → RX"; the green wire runs from the microphone upstairs to the door's speaker, marked "RX ← TX".
